import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define file paths for all sources
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/test_4.csv"
    path_target = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_37/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load all source tables
    df_0 = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)
    df_1 = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)
    df_2 = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)
    df_3 = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)
    df_4 = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)

    # Inspect and drop any unnamed index columns if present (common when saving/loading CSVs)
    for df in [df_0, df_1, df_2, df_3, df_4]:
        unnamed_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Unnamed")]
        if unnamed_cols:
            df.drop(columns=unnamed_cols, inplace=True)

    # The main large table is df_2, which already contains most columns of the target schema.
    # We need to replace the columns that are coded as strings but have corresponding Id columns in other sources:
    # Intervencion (df_0), Deteccion (df_1), Actividad (df_3), Causa (df_4)
    # The target schema requires the Id columns for these categorical fields as well.

    # Step 1: Merge df_2 with df_0 on 'Intervencion' to get IdInterv
    # But df_0 has IdInterv and Intervencion, df_2 has Intervencion string.
    # We'll do a left join from df_2 to df_0 on Intervencion to get IdInterv.
    df_2 = df_2.merge(df_0, on="Intervencion", how="left", validate="many_to_one")

    # Step 2: Merge df_2 with df_1 on 'Deteccion' to get IdDeteccion
    df_2 = df_2.merge(df_1, on="Deteccion", how="left", validate="many_to_one")

    # Step 3: Merge df_2 with df_3 on 'Actividad' to get IdActividad
    df_2 = df_2.merge(df_3, on="Actividad", how="left", validate="many_to_one")

    # Step 4: Merge df_2 with df_4 on 'Causa' to get IdCausa
    df_2 = df_2.merge(df_4, on="Causa", how="left", validate="many_to_one")

    # After merges, df_2 should have all columns required by the target schema.
    # The target schema columns are:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdInterv'
    ]

    # Note: Source df_2 has a column 'Precipitaciones' which is not in target schema, so we ignore it.
    # Also, 'Dir. vi.' column name contains a dot and space, keep as is.

    # Ensure all target columns exist in df_2
    missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_2.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    df_target = df_2[target_columns]

    # Cast columns to target types as specified:
    # 'Fecha': string (already string)
    # 'IdAhogado': integer
    # 'IdPersona': integer
    # 'Localidad': string
    # 'Provincia': string
    # 'CCAA': string
    # 'Hora': string
    # 'Latitud_inc': float
    # 'Longitud_inc': float
    # 'Sexo': string
    # 'Edad': float
    # 'Nacionalidad': string
    # 'Origen': string
    # 'Extraccion': string
    # 'Causa': string
    # 'TipoAhogamiento': string
    # 'Factor': string
    # 'Intervencion': string
    # 'Pronostico': string
    # 'Localizacion': string
    # 'Riesgo': string
    # 'Reanimacion': string
    # 'Vigilancia': string
    # 'Actividad': string
    # 'Deteccion': string
    # 'ID': integer
    # 'Estacion': string
    # 'Estado': string
    # 'Latitud_est': float
    # 'Longitud_est': float
    # 'T_med': float
    # 'T_max': float
    # 'T_min': float
    # 'Presion': float
    # 'Dir. vi.': float
    # 'V_Viento': integer
    # 'Nubosidad': float
    # 'ProfNievecm': float
    # 'InsolacHoras': float
    # 'Distancia': float
    # 'IdActividad': integer
    # 'IdCausa': integer
    # 'IdDeteccion': integer
    # 'IdInterv': integer

    # Define casting dictionary
    cast_dict = {
        'IdAhogado': 'Int64',
        'IdPersona': 'Int64',
        'Edad': 'float64',
        'Latitud_inc': 'float64',
        'Longitud_inc': 'float64',
        'Latitud_est': 'float64',
        'Longitud_est': 'float64',
        'T_med': 'float64',
        'T_max': 'float64',
        'T_min': 'float64',
        'Presion': 'float64',
        'Dir. vi.': 'float64',
        'V_Viento': 'Int64',
        'Nubosidad': 'float64',
        'ProfNievecm': 'float64',
        'InsolacHoras': 'float64',
        'Distancia': 'float64',
        'ID': 'Int64',
        'IdActividad': 'Int64',
        'IdCausa': 'Int64',
        'IdDeteccion': 'Int64',
        'IdInterv': 'Int64'
    }

    # Cast columns
    for col, dtype in cast_dict.items():
        if col in df_target.columns:
            df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype(dtype)

    # For string columns, ensure they are string type (object)
    string_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Sexo', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen',
        'Extraccion', 'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico',
        'Localizacion', 'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion',
        'Estacion', 'Estado'
    ]
    for col in string_columns:
        if col in df_target.columns:
            df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(str).replace({'nan': None})

    # Save the final dataframe to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(path_target, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
